Copy this file to `notes/posts/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.qmd` — the date in the filename
matches the `date:` field, and the slug becomes the URL. All four fields above are
required; `categories` is optional.

Write the entry here. Code fences, images and tables all work; put any images in
`notes/posts/images/` and reference them as `images/foo.png`.
